defect: Heartbeat accumulator discarded elapsed time above 0.3 seconds on a long frame, delaying income and toy production.
reproduction: Canonical whole-server Lua harness: Heartbeat 0.6s followed by 0.12s x3 (0.96s total) credits only 0.66s on prior source; 6 coins/s yields 3 instead of 5. A further 0.3s also delays first toy.
root_cause: RunService.Heartbeat capped delta to 0.3 but reset accumulated=0, throwing away the unprocessed remainder.
fix: Keep accumulated=accumulated-delta, allowing bounded one-step-per-Heartbeat catch-up without changing per-step 0.3 cap.
character_impact: No character stats or prices changed; transient server lag no longer permanently slows income/production for PON, GUARDON and TANKURU.

tests.negative_control: Old main source deterministically discards 0.3s in the specified 0.6s frame; negative execution not run locally

next_action: Confirm exact-head Toy Wars bootstrap offline QA; repair the same draft if it fails; independent reviewer handles integration.
